headline: Introducing The ChatGPT Ads Launch Kit, Free for DTC Brands on Shopify
subhead: OpenAI opened ChatGPT Ads to Shopify stores, with more countries from September 23. Five ChatGPT skills to set it up right, one file per skill, free to keep.
subhead_secondary: Paste what you already have underneath a skill and it answers, or it names the exact field it's missing.
inside: Readiness check: 14 setup items, each tied to the OpenAI rule behind it
Click math: the conversion rate a click at your bid has to hit, on your own numbers
Catalog rewriter: product titles and descriptions rebuilt from facts your rows already state
Shopper question bank: up to 30 pre-purchase questions, answered in your store's own words
Ad variations and context hints: eight angles, each resting on a fact about the product
proof: Built by the team that runs paid growth for DTC brands. RISE buys media for DTC brands and gets paid on the growth it adds. Every platform rule in the kit is sourced to OpenAI's own documentation, read September 19, 2026.
